propositions: The reconciler baseline is advanced from the pass-START snapshot (last-fetched) rather than the last-SYNCED value, causing it to lag by one pass after rebar itself pushes a field outbound

A local status change equal to the stale baseline is suppressed from outbound by the _suppressed_by_inbound guard, allowing inbound to overwrite it with Jira's remote value, silently clobbering the local edit

Per-mutation success (specifically completion of client.update_issue without exception) must be the gate for baseline advancement, not pass exit code, since status transitions can soft-fail while the pass still exits 0

The ABA exposure (baseline B, local pushed to A, local reverted to B mid-window) affects all five inbound-mirrored fields (summary/description/priority/status/assignee) because all share the same _suppressed_by_inbound guard
Direction-preservation cells for title exist on the live path but status equivalents drive only the unproductive _diff_fields adapter, leaving status pinning absent until live-path cells are added
